title: Add MealPlanFiles helper for plans subfolder I/O
description: Create the app-layer file helper mirroring `ShoppingListFiles` for `<folder>/plans/` discovery, display naming, and bracketed reads/writes.
acceptance_criteria: `MealPlanFiles.discover(in:)` returns only `.menu` files sorted by reverse modification date.
`displayName`, `readText`, and `writeText` mirror the shopping-list helper behaviour for meal plans.
Security-scoped access is bracketed consistently with existing file helpers.

handoff_summary.completed: All four acceptance criteria satisfied: `plansURL(in:)` creates/returns `<folder>/plans/`; `discover(in:)` returns only `.menu` files sorted reverse-chronologically; `displayName`, `readText`, and `writeText` mirror the shopping-list helper; security-scoped access is bracketed identically in every method. `CookbookApp/MealPlans/` directory created as well.
handoff_summary.risks: The `MealPlans/` directory is new and not yet referenced by the Xcode project file; downstream beads that add SwiftUI views or other sources to this group will need to add the directory to the `.xcodeproj` target. This is a normal ordering dependency, not a blocker for this helper alone.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify `plansURL`, `discover`, `displayName`, `readText`, and `writeText` behave correctly. Downstream beads adding SwiftUI views should add `CookbookApp/MealPlans/` to the Xcode target.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflicts expected; file is new. Beads that add to `CookbookApp/MealPlans/` must add the group to the `.xcodeproj` target membership.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Subfolder name is `plans` (not `meal-plans`) matching the spec. Extension filter is case-insensitive (`lowercased() == "menu"`) consistent with the `.md` filter in `ShoppingListFiles`. `dropLast(5)` removes the 5-character `.menu` suffix in `displayName`.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written by developer (tester agent responsibility). All four public methods are pure filesystem operations and can be tested with a temp directory fixture.

conflict_risks: No conflicts expected; file is new. Beads that add to `CookbookApp/MealPlans/` must add the group to the `.xcodeproj` target membership.
